FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ElectraSupply Solutions specializes in the wholesale distribution of high-quality electrical components and supplies, particularly UL-listed products, catering to both residential and light commercial markets. Our operations focus on providing a comprehensive inventory of electrical supplies, including wiring, lighting fixtures, outlets, and connectors. We maintain strict compliance with all relevant safety and regulatory standards, including the National Electrical Code (NEC) and Underwriters Laboratories (UL) guidelines. Our knowledgeable team supports customers with expert advice ensuring they find the right products for their needs. With efficient inventory management and logistics, we ensure timely delivery and customer satisfaction without engaging in high-voltage or hazardous electrical equipment manufacturing or installation services.

FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 03/15/2023; Cause: Water damage due to a burst pipe in the storage area; Amount: $2,500; Status: Claim settled.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM; Closed on Sunday
